name: Owari no Mori 2
source:
A few years after Colt entered the forest, the originally weak Philum also became an adventurer after recovering.
In a tavern where she stayed, Philum heard that Colt's last direction was "Slave's Forest."
In order to track down her sister's whereabouts, she also headed towards the forest—

But what greets her in front will be her sister, whom she has not seen for many years, or perhaps more...desperation…?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264480/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
柯尔特进入森林几年后，原本虚弱的菲鲁姆在康复后也成为了一名冒险家。
在她下榻的一家小酒馆里，菲勒姆听说柯尔特最后的方向是“奴隶森林”。
为了追查妹妹的下落，她也前往了森林——

但眼前迎接她的将是多年未见的妹妹，或者更多的是……绝望……？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264480/]Steam[/url]]
